english.title: Cause / permit discharge of hydrocarbon / matter / substance at Luton Airport - obstruct / risk to health
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the discharge of

(C)_[a hydrocarbon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HYDROCARBON..),]_
(D)_[deleterious matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATTER..),]_
(E)_[a substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SUBSTANCE..),]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Luton Airport which might

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.41 and 7.1 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause / permit the discharge of
hydrocarbon / deleterious matter / other substance
at Luton Airport
which might obstruct / be / become a source of
damage to drains / sewers / infrastructure OR
constitute a risk to the environment / public health
